newsitem.title: UGANDA: 76 Ugandans said killed by Kenyan cattle rustlers.
newsitem.headline: 76 Ugandans said killed by Kenyan cattle rustlers.

text.p: At least 76 villagers were killed in northeastern Uganda last Wednesday by cattle rustlers from Kenya, the state-owned New Vision newspaper reported on Monday.
New Vision said 50 children and 26 adults from the Pokot ethnic group were killed during a cattle raid by rustlers from the Matheniko Karamojong and Turkana of northwestern Kenya.
A total of 366 head of cattle were stolen in the raid on Chemakany village, the newspaper reported.

There was no Ugandan government statement on the killings but the New Vision said that the raid came at a time Pokot communal guards were attending a seminar organised by the Uganda Revenue Authority and the Anti-Stock Theft Unit.
Cattle rustling is common in northern Kenya and Uganda.
